subject: Start of the 120th Congress
query: when does the new congress take office
title: When does the new Congress take office? Noon on Jan. 3, 2027
answer: The new Congress takes office at noon on Sunday, Jan. 3, 2027. That is when the 120th Congress, elected in the Nov. 3, 2026, midterms, begins and the terms of the outgoing members end. The 20th Amendment sets Jan. 3 as the date, though Congress can choose a different day by law.
body:
Section 1 of the 20th Amendment says the terms of senators and representatives end "at noon on the 3d day of January" and that "the terms of their successors shall then begin." Section 2 says Congress shall assemble at noon on Jan. 3 "unless they shall by law appoint a different day." Because Jan. 3, 2027, falls on a Sunday, the swearing-in could be moved by law; WSOC-TV noted that since 1995 the latest a Congress has been seated is Jan. 7 (in 1997 and 2003).

According to the AP, Democrats won control of both chambers in the 2026 midterms. Until Jan. 3, the outgoing 119th Congress keeps working in a lame duck session that begins Nov. 9, 2026. On its first day, the new House elects a speaker; Rep. Hakeem Jeffries is the front-runner, according to WSOC-TV.
in_the_news: After the Nov. 3, 2026, midterms, in which the AP reported Democrats winning both the House and Senate, many are asking when the new majority actually takes over.

faq.q: When do Democrats take control of the House?
faq.a: When the 120th Congress convenes, set by the 20th Amendment for noon on Jan. 3, 2027, unless Congress sets a different day by law.

faq.q: When are new members of Congress sworn in?
faq.a: On the first day of the new Congress, which the 20th Amendment sets for noon on Jan. 3 unless Congress picks another day by law.

faq.q: What happens between the election and Jan. 3?
faq.a: The outgoing Congress can still meet and pass laws. This period is called the lame duck session; in 2026 it begins Nov. 9.
